view_contract.CSV: One row per mapped data row. c1_value/c1_sd through c7_value/c7_sd and qualified/planned preserve printed precision. Unit, mean-case count, fixed-policy count, source refs and gate metadata are separate fields.
view_contract.HTML: New static numeric tables, units, SDs, existing pass/planned columns and explicit gate metadata; no external resources.
view_contract.TeX: New table fragment with 13 tabular parts and fresh technical labels. It can be included with booktabs and graphicx; no TeX/PDF compiler is run.
view_contract.Q5: The five original numeric columns are retained. The separate gate metadata preserves both rule/full-residual pass counts; only full-residual enforces the recorded 90% paid-service floor.
view_contract.Q6: The five historical low-level full-residual rows already include the 90% floor. Economic rows retain their source-study physical/recovery/service gates. No new admission test is imposed.
view_contract.archival_Q1: Numeric reported values only; no original table_tex body or manuscript label strings are emitted. Only the narrow PID relief mean/SD have a separately recorded reproduction.
view_contract.new_PID: Diagnostic means retain all complete cases including qualification failures.

validation.before_output_write: Bind numeric values to source reports, parse the newly generated TeX with the exhaustive validator, recompute approved scalar-case aggregates, and round-trip CSV/HTML numeric fields.
validation.source_hash_mode: --check-source-hashes checks the 13 original numeric JSON byte digests; normalized derivatives need separately recorded transformation receipts.
validation.generated_TeX_hash: Derived output hash only. Historical original TeX digest is retained as provenance, not enforced as a layout/byte target.
validation.four_earlier_absolute_economic_Q6_rows: Report-bound values/counts/cash references; archived per-episode traces are not a renderer dependency.

frozen_view.role: Existing approved frozen PDF, preserved separately

excluded_dependencies: Original paper ZIP, manuscript source, original TeX or manuscript prose
Original comparison_data.json and its table_tex field
Original build_comparison_pdf.py, make_document(data) or archive-reading assemble()
Input datasets, simulator/runtime evaluator/trainer code or checkpoint archives
Raw archived episodes, private session evidence, attachments or live artifact URLs

output_safety.physical_destination: --output-dir can place generated deliverables outside a read-only evidence tree without serializing that machine-local path
output_safety.overwrite: Existing different generated files require --overwrite; fixed source reports/PDF are never output targets
